raw_ocr_text: NOTE: The original LLM extraction incorrectly extracted a 5-call rectangular description from the deed body, which stated 'BEGINNING at a point in the southwesterly line of Pennbrook Drive 145 feet southwesterly from the southwestern side of Concord Place; thence (1) South 53° 50' 56" West a distance of 125 feet to a corner; thence (2) South 36° 09' 04" East a distance of 142 feet to a corner; thence (3) North 53° 50' 56" East a distance of 125 feet to a point in a line of Pennbrook Drive; thence (4) North 36° 09' 04" West along and along the southwesterly line of Pennbrook Drive 142 feet to the place of BEGINNING.' However, the deed clearly states 'SEE EXHIBIT "A" ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF' in the Property section. The correct legal description is in Exhibit A (pages 5/6 of the deed), which describes a 7-call L-shaped lot. This ground truth now reflects the correct Exhibit A description.

notes: Ground truth corrected on 2026-02-16 to reflect the actual Exhibit A legal description. The original GT was based on an incorrect 5-call rectangular description that the LLM extracted from the deed body, but the deed clearly references 'SEE EXHIBIT "A" ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF'. Exhibit A describes a 7-call L-shaped lot with only 2 calls having complete DMS bearings (S 56°40' W and S 87°07'30" W). The remaining 5 calls are cardinal-only directions (southwestwardly, southeastwardly, northeastwardly, etc.) and should be flagged with bearing_quadrant=null, bearing_azimuth_deg_from_north=null, and notes='incomplete bearing - cardinal only'. Due to insufficient bearing data (only 2 of 7 calls have computable bearings), closure verification cannot be performed and closure_passed=false. The parcel is an L-shaped irregular polygon, not the rectangular parcel described in the incorrect body text.
